mapper.insert:

INSERT INTO inventory_sync_run ( client_request_id, request_hash, trigger_type, run_status, active_scope_key, fencing_token, main_attempt_no, requested_by, requested_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{clientRequestId}, #{requestHash}, #{triggerType}, 'QUEUED', 'INVENTORY_CANONICAL', 1, 0, #{requestedBy}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET run_status = 'RUNNING', current_phase = 'READING', main_attempt_no = #{attemptNo}, fencing_token = #{fencingToken}, lease_owner_instance_id = #{owner}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, SYSTIMESTAMP), heartbeat_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND active_scope_key = 'INVENTORY_CANONICAL' AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND run_status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET current_phase = #{phase}, read_count = #{readCount}, mapped_count = #{mappedCount}, heartbeat_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND main_attempt_no = #{attemptNo} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND run_status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET run_status = #{status}, current_phase = NULL, changed_count = #{changedCount}, error_code = #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_count = CASE WHEN #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN error_count ELSE error_count + 1 END, active_scope_key = NULL, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND main_attempt_no = #{attemptNo} AND fencing_token = #{fencingToken} AND run_status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId}
mapper.select: SELECT source_type FROM inventory_source_state ORDER BY source_type
SELECT current_version FROM inventory_source_state WHERE source_type = #{sourceType}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET run_status = 'QUEUED', current_phase = NULL, main_attempt_no = main_attempt_no + 1, fencing_token = fencing_token + 1, main_batch_job_execution_id = NULL, lease_owner_instance_id = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status IN ('INTERRUPTED', 'QUEUED') AND (run_status = 'INTERRUPTED' OR requested_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now}) AND (lease_owner_instance_id IS NULL OR heartbeat_at IS NULL OR heartbeat_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE)

UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET run_status = 'INTERRUPTED', current_phase = NULL, error_code = 'WORKER_STALE', error_message = 'worker lease가 만료되어 운영자 복구가 필요합니다.', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'RUNNING' AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL OR lease_expires_at <= #{now}) AND (heartbeat_at IS NULL OR heartbeat_at <= #{now} - INTERVAL '5' MINUTE)

UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET run_status = 'LAUNCH_FAILED', active_scope_key = NULL, error_code = 'LAUNCH_REJECTED', error_message = #{message}, completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId} AND run_status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE inventory_sync_run SET main_batch_job_execution_id = #{executionId}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE inventory_sync_run_id = #{runId}
